subject: SIG/CAIQ initiation: prefill checklist & evidence-owner map
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finwise.io>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finwise.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2024 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ initiation: prefill checklist & evidence-owner map

Hi Laura / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the security intake for the HW-4532 deal: 

- Redwood asks: we'd like to initiate a SIG/CAIQ prefill so your security team can either upload CAIQ answers directly or attach a CAIQ-to-SIG mapping. That helps speed vendor review.
- Immediate clarifying items from our side: SOC 2 type (I/II) and date, whether FinWise processes EEA personal data (and any residency constraints), and whether you require a bespoke questionnaire (you mentioned a short custom form) or are OK with standard CAIQ.
- Evidence: we typically request the latest SOC 2 report (do you have a non-redacted version or a bridge letter?), network diagram for flow-of-PII (PDF), and an owner for questionnaire completion.

Attachment: I’ve attached a short SIG-prefill-template.xlsx to make it easier — if you prefer, your security team can fill CAIQ CSV instead. Can you confirm:

1) Who will own completing the prefill? (security@finwise.io OK?)
2) Do you have a target date to return the prefill/evidence (we recommend ~7 business days for initial pass)?
3) Any special scope: HIPAA / PHI handling or EU-only residency?

Proposed next step: once you confirm ownership, we’ll send a HubSpot link and a shared Drive folder for secure upload. If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with our security engineer to go over mappings.

Thanks — I’ll ping Ben and Karthik to own evidence mapping internally.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
(650) 555-0183

Attachments: SIG-prefill-template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finwise.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finwise.io>, security@finwise.io
Date: Wed, 19 Jun 2024 09:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ initiation: prefill checklist & evidence-owner map

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers from FinWise: 

- SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type II report (period ending 2023-11). We can share a redacted copy; security@finwise.io will handle uploads.
- Data residency: we do process EEA personal data and have EU-hosted clusters for customers that require it — but FinWise’s default deployment is US-first (we can note residency per-account).
- HIPAA: FinWise does support PHI in certain integrations under BAAs — for this POC there is no PHI expected, but we can confirm with the product team if that changes.
- Questionnaire: security@finwise.io prefers to fill the standard CAIQ export. They mentioned a smaller custom form would be OK if you provide field mapping.

I’ve looped in Tom (engineering) and our security alias to take ownership. We expect someone to start on the prefill by next Tuesday. We’ll upload the SOC 2 redacted PDF and a network diagram to the folder you send.

Laura Chen
Head of Customer Security, FinWise
laura.chen@finwise.io

Thanks Laura — great to hear you have the Type II report available. Couple clarifications from the Redwood security intake side (so FinWise can scope evidence collection).

1) Preferred intake format: CAIQ export is perfect. If you fill our SIG-prefill-template.xlsx that’s also fine; we have a small mapping script to translate CAIQ -> SIG fields.

2) Evidence checklist (what we’ll request after prefill review): 
   - SOC 2 Type II (redacted PDF)
   - Network diagram (flow-of-PII) 
   - List of subprocessors with country locations (CSV)
   - Data retention policy excerpt (PDF)
   - Access control policy / IAM summary (one-page PDF)

3) Ownership and timeline: Jasmine recommended ~7 business days for a first pass. Can we set an internal target to review the prefills within 3 business days of upload so we can surface blocking items? Karthik and I will own the review on Redwood’s side.

4) HIPAA / PHI: If FinWise ends up processing PHI for this integration, please flag that up front — we’ll move to a BAA conversation and surface specific evidence asks (audit logs, encryption-at-rest key management).

I’ve attached a short redwood-evidence-checklist.pdf that maps evidences to the CAIQ sections to make it explicit.

Next step for FinWise: upload CAIQ export or fill the attached spreadsheet in the Drive link Jasmine will send. Once we get the upload, Karthik will run the mapping and reach out for any clarifications.

—Ben
